variants.headline: Two settlements, different fortunes
body: Between turns {{fromTurn}} and {{toTurn}}, population in {{cityLink}} changed by {{growth}}, while {{otherCityLink}} changed by {{otherGrowth}}.
Compare food and current production in the city screen to understand the difference and decide whether either settlement needs attention.

variants.headline: {{city}} and {{otherCity}} take different paths
body: Our settlements do not move at one pace. Recorded population in {{cityLink}} changed by {{growth}}; in {{otherCity}}, by {{otherGrowth}}, over the comparison ending at turn {{toTurn}}.
A city that grows more slowly may be serving another purpose. Review its food balance and current work before drawing a conclusion.

variants.headline: The {{partner}} route balance
body: At turn {{tradeToTurn}}, routes to {{partnerLink}} brought {{gold}} gold per turn, or {{share}}% of positive gold from our outgoing foreign routes. The earlier share was {{previousShare}}% at turn {{tradeFromTurn}}.
The trade screen shows the connections behind these figures. Review the route mix when weighing the benefits of another connection with this partner.

variants.headline: Merchant routes redraw the balance
body: {{partnerLink}} accounted for {{share}}% of our positive outgoing foreign-route gold at turn {{tradeToTurn}}, compared with {{previousShare}}% at turn {{tradeFromTurn}}.
The routes supplied {{gold}} gold per turn in the later observation. Review the route mix when considering future connections.

variants.headline: {{partner}}'s cultural pace changes
body: Reports from {{partnerLink}} show culture per turn changing from {{previousCulture}} at turn {{cultureFromTurn}} to {{culture}} at turn {{cultureToTurn}}.
Cultural output is one way to follow a neighbor's development. Keep this change in view alongside later diplomatic and cultural reports.

variants.headline: A cultural dispatch from {{partner}}
body: Recorded culture per turn in {{partnerLink}} is {{culture}}, compared with {{previousCulture}} in the earlier observation. Those observations date to turns {{cultureFromTurn}} and {{cultureToTurn}}.

variants.headline: War reaches our civilization
body: A declaration of war involving {{partnerLink}} targeted our team at turn {{eventTurn}}.
Review exposed cities, trade routes, and military positions. The military screen can help you decide where the declaration demands an immediate response.

variants.headline: A declaration of war against our team
body: At turn {{eventTurn}}, the recorded war declaration involving {{partnerLink}} named our team as its target. Consider the immediate safety of cities and routes while reviewing the military screen.

variants.headline: An exchange with {{partner}}
body: Our civilization and {{partnerLink}} concluded a deal at turn {{eventTurn}}. Review the exchange in the diplomatic overview as you consider the next step in this relationship.

variants.headline: Peace with {{partner}}
body: A peace event involving our team and {{partnerLink}} was recorded at turn {{eventTurn}}. Peace creates room to review damaged routes and city priorities; recovery will need later observations.

variants.headline: {{city}} regains population
body: Following an earlier decline, population in {{cityLink}} rose by {{growth}} between turns {{fromTurn}} and {{toTurn}}, reaching {{population}}. Compare its food balance and current production to see how the growing settlement can serve the nation.

variants.headline: Merchants and envoys look toward {{partner}}
body: Routes to {{partnerLink}} accounted for {{share}}% of positive outgoing foreign-route gold at turn {{tradeToTurn}}, compared with {{previousShare}}% at turn {{tradeFromTurn}}. A deal with the same partner was recorded at turn {{eventTurn}}.
Merchants and envoys both have business with this partner. Consider the route balance alongside the exchange when reviewing the relationship.

variants.headline: {{city}} rebounds as settlement fortunes diverge
body: After an earlier population decline, {{cityLink}} gained {{recoveryGrowth}} population between turns {{recoveryFromTurn}} and {{recoveryToTurn}}, reaching {{population}}. Across the comparison at turns {{contrastFromTurn}} and {{contrastToTurn}}, {{otherCity}} changed by {{otherGrowth}}.
The rebound gives this settlement a fresh place in the provincial account. Compare food and current production in both cities when reviewing their next priorities.

variants.headline: War and the {{partner}} route account
body: A declaration of war involving {{partnerLink}} targeted our team at turn {{eventTurn}}. The route observation at turn {{tradeToTurn}} placed {{share}}% of positive outgoing foreign-route gold with this partner, compared with {{previousShare}}% at turn {{tradeFromTurn}}.
Review exposed trade connections alongside cities and military positions. The route figures describe the dated observation and provide context for the decisions ahead.

variants.headline: Two views of {{partner}}
body: Routes to {{partnerLink}} supplied {{share}}% of positive outgoing foreign-route gold at turn {{tradeToTurn}}. Cultural output there changed from {{previousCulture}} per turn at turn {{cultureFromTurn}} to {{culture}} at turn {{cultureToTurn}}.
The routes keep this neighbor in the merchant account; its changing cultural output gives the wider world another reason to pay attention. Follow both measures in later dispatches.
